comparison: Native SM100 attention forward versus hero wide segmented forward; native SM100 backward fixed in both arms.

hardware.pair_allocation: Same physical GPUs for both arms; fresh interpreters and source snapshots.

protocol.purpose: Four fresh pairs of restored hero training, each running both arms in fresh processes within one physical 64-GPU allocation.
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Select latest complete hero checkpoint once at pair setup in-region; temporarily retain until both arms are terminal; require identical restored URI and step; restore original retention metadata.
protocol.rack_policy: A pair holds one 16-host, 64-GB200 allocation through both arms. Require identical task/attempt, hostname, local GPU UUIDs, local device assignment and NVLink rack for both arms; no retries or migration.

statistics.estimand: mean(control run-mean duration) / mean(native run-mean duration) - 1
statistics.primary: All relative steps 8 through 27 inclusive, equal run weighting. Pair is the replicate. Paired Fieller 95% throughput interval with t critical value for 3 degrees of freedom. Also report paired-t seconds saved.
statistics.sensitivity: Exclude absolute step numbers divisible by 10; retain all other primary samples.
statistics.decision: Require positive lower primary throughput interval and acceptable provenance and numerical evidence before promotion. No timing-based early acceptance or extra pairs.
statistics.invalid_runs: Retain and report failed or provenance-mismatched runs; pause and investigate. Do not replace based on duration. Any protocol amendment must precede further measurements.

protocol.loss_policy: Record all 28 finite losses per arm and compare at matched restored steps, indexed 0 through 27. Define differences as treatment minus control cross-entropy in nats; report initial difference, signed mean, maximum absolute difference, last-seven mean and every per-step difference. Same-sign differences at all 20 scored steps trigger investigation before promotion, as do nonfinite values or other unexplained sustained drift. Exact initial-loss equality is not required for changed BF16 arithmetic. The corrected hero selector passed 25 GPU reference tests and four padding/reuse tests at unchanged tolerances. Short trajectories cannot establish long-term convergence or numerical equivalence.
protocol.baseline_policy: Native SM100 backward is fixed in both arms. Neither registration-only nor copy-engine all-gather is promoted. Default NCCL policy and ragged-all-to-all-only registration remain fixed.

excluded_study.reason: Both arms selected segmented forward; none of its samples enters this study.

protocol.kernel_validation: After each arm, rank 0 parses its local two-step XPlane capture in-region and broadcasts observed attention kernel counts. Require 192 forward launches of the intended implementation and 96 native SM100 backward launches, with zero launches of the other forward implementation. Any mismatch fails the job and stops submission of subsequent arms. Timing ends before this validation. Saved profiles also support final provenance and bottleneck analysis.
protocol.timeout_scope: Aggregate 55-minute GPU-process deadline covers both arms, source preparation and validation; queue time is excluded.

protocol_amendment.reason: The prior study independently scheduled each arm. Pair 2 used two different NVLink racks and failed the predeclared provenance gate. Preserve its observations without pooling them; use four new predeclared pairs under enforced same-allocation placement.
protocol_amendment.same_allocation_implementation: Each rank copies frozen common source, applies exact per-arm source files, and executes each arm in a fresh interpreter. Separate JAX endpoints and ports prevent reuse of a preceding coordinator.
protocol_amendment.selection: No duration-based replacement, exclusion, added pair or early acceptance.

protocol.correctness_gates_pending: Updated four-GPU gate must validate full configuration preparation and Levanter initialization without completing the enclosing job. Restored 64-GPU paired training and loss/profile validation remain pending.

prior_selection_screen.scope: Synthetic single-GPU screen with correlated timing batches, not a training-throughput result

configuration_transport.format: Base64-encoded cloudpickle, matching Iris callable argument transport.
configuration_transport.reason: The complete GrugRunConfig is not round-trip-decodable by draccus; the prior attempt failed at resource decoding before JAX initialization or training.
configuration_transport.training_config_preview: Dry-run output includes the complete encoded configuration alongside each transported payload.

prior_paired_gate.scope: Attention output/gradient reference, four-rank all-gather and process/source isolation. Did not decode full training configuration.

log_directory_preparation.failure: Profiler setup attempted trainer.log_dir / run_id / profiler after the launcher assigned a string to log_dir. All 64 ranks initialized; no training-loop samples were recorded.
log_directory_preparation.fix: Preserve pathlib.Path while placing each arm log directory under IRIS_OUTPUT_DIR.
log_directory_preparation.cpu_regression: Full configuration transport and preparation in a fresh process, actual profiler construction, and full configuration comparison except the intended log directory.

prior_configuration_gate.scope: Full configuration decoding, independent attention output/gradient reference, four-rank all-gather and process/source isolation. Attention source is unchanged by the subsequent log-directory fix.

paired_job_lifecycle.cause: Levanter DistributedConfig.initialize registered a rank-0 exit hook that completed the enclosing Iris job after the control subprocess exited. Iris stopped the allocation before treatment started.
paired_job_lifecycle.fix: Disable Levanter automatic distributed initialization in each prepared arm config. The paired launcher already initializes JAX explicitly, shuts it down per arm, and owns the enclosing job lifecycle.
paired_job_lifecycle.cpu_regression: Real single-process CPU JAX startup and shutdown with a file-backed Iris completion RPC. The old configuration completed the enclosing job at process exit.
paired_job_lifecycle.gpu_gate_change: Exercise the prepared trainer distributed initialization path before reference attention and all-gather checks; require both arms and all parent process-finish records.

statistics.caveat: Four planned matched pairs with one physical 64-GPU allocation per pair; all relative steps 8 through 27 included with equal run weighting. Paired t and Fieller intervals use three degrees of freedom and assume independent approximately normal run-pair means. Failed preceding attempts and earlier exploratory studies are excluded and preserved. Twenty-eight matched losses per arm do not establish long-term convergence.

2.trigger: All 20 scored native-minus-control loss differences are negative; retain this flag.
evidence: Both arms have 28 finite matched losses and passed all 64-rank source, physical-device, checkpoint and runtime checks.
Detailed profiles have the expected native/segmented forward and native backward kernels and unchanged ragged geometry.
The loss gap is largest at update 14 and smaller over updates 21–27. No monotone divergence appears in this short window.
Padding metrics match exactly. Router entropy, overflow and bias differences appear in both pairs; routing trajectories are not identical.
The exact frozen sources passed the four-GPU value/gradient gate at existing tolerances. Earlier hero-selector reference and padding/reuse tests also passed.
limits: The loss offset has no proven mechanism; changed BF16 arithmetic and subsequent routing are plausible contributors.
Existing reference tolerances are unchanged. No cross-entropy equivalence tolerance is invented from this observation.
Proceed with the original four measurements; retain pair 2 without replacement or timing-based exclusion.
This decision does not establish numerical equivalence, long-term convergence, or authorize production deployment.
Final assessment must report this flag and review all four loss trajectories; any later flagged pair requires its own review.

paired_correctness_gate.scope: Full training config prepared and Levanter initialization exercised without premature Iris completion in each isolated source, four GB200 GPUs on one host, attention outputs/gradients at unchanged tolerances, all-gather, process restart and identical device assignments. No restored training or multi-host throughput claim.

publication_scope: Timing, loss, compact memory totals and protocol metadata. No raw profiles, checkpoint contents, credentials or detailed profile contents.
source_availability: Exact source commits and hashes are recorded. Corrected native-forward production and paired harness source are not yet publicly published.
limitations: Four predeclared paired replicates; individual steps are not independent replications.
Twenty-eight restored updates do not establish long-term convergence.
Compiler-planned totals and rank-zero JAX allocator counters do not measure whole-device memory across all allocators.
Each pair selects the latest completed hero checkpoint once; checkpoints can differ between pairs.
The training batch is 1024; optimizer schedule parameters retain production batch 11264.
Earlier failed and invalid studies are excluded and preserved in the protocol.
